user.title: Connect to TrueNAS SCALE
user.description: Requires TrueNAS SCALE 25.04 or newer. Create an API key in TrueNAS (top-right user menu → API Keys). The connection always uses HTTPS: TrueNAS revokes a key used over plain HTTP.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, optionally with :port.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off with the default self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {host} was refused. Enter a new one.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two reads. Live statistics (CPU, network, memory) are pushed by TrueNAS.
data_description.filter_spurious_temps: Some NVMe SSDs (Samsung 980 family) intermittently report exactly 84 °C because of a firmware issue. When on, those readings are replaced by the last good value; the raw value stays in the attributes.
